name: Andrzej Halicki - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 2/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Update on revenue (own resources) and adjustments to expenditure
part_text:
The European Parliament approves changes to the European Union's 2026 budget. The changes add money for payments: 5.4 billion euros more for regional and cohesion programmes and 2.2 billion euros more for rural development under farm policy. They also raise the European Union's income, so member states pay 4.36 billion euros more than in the previous budget update. The Parliament also asks the Commission to watch the security situation on the eastern borders and to fund maritime security hubs.

- Payments rise by 8 billion euros, mostly for cohesion and farm programmes.
- Member states pay 4.36 billion euros more into the European Union budget.
- The Parliament asks the Commission to assess border security costs and possibly propose more budget changes.
